default_mechanics: While you have Minor Strain, take -1 on your next d20 roll that meaningfully relates to the cause (GM decides).
Minor Strain clears on a short rest, or earlier if fictionally addressed (warmth, witness, ritual, remedy).
minor_strain.stacking: If gained again while you already have it, GM may escalate to 'Major Strain' (optional) or apply a second -1 to a later relevant roll.

suggested_spell_feature_tagging: Prefer explicit tags on spells/features in your toolchain; use damage types as fallback.
Fallback mapping examples: fire->fire; cold->ice/water; thunder->air; lightning->air(storm); poison/disease->charnelix_blight; psychic/fear/illusion/silence->varook_silence; bludgeoning/stone->earth.

flight_system.design_goal: Cinematic flight that scales by level and costs resources/strain, so low-level play stays grounded.

aerial_strain_track.name: Aerial Strain
gain_triggers: Flying while wearing medium/heavy armor or while heavily encumbered (+1)
Flying in severe conditions (storm, whiteout, spore cloud, veilstorm) (+1)
Exceeding your tier's allowed duration (+1 per round beyond)

effects: Disadvantage on your next Acrobatics check made in the air or to land safely.
Your flying speed is halved until you finish a short rest (or you must land at end of your turn).
Forced Landing: you must land at the end of your current turn; gain Minor Strain. You cannot fly again until after a short rest.

recovery: Short rest in safe shelter reduces Aerial Strain by 2.
Long rest reduces Aerial Strain to 0.

aerial_mastery_ladder.name: Jump + Glide
capabilities: Enhanced jumps (narrative + minor mechanical: advantage on Athletics checks to jump/climb in open space).
Reaction Glide: when falling, reduce fall damage and steer up to 10 ft per 10 ft fallen (no hovering).
limits: No sustained flight; must start from solid ground or a fall.

aerial_mastery_ladder.name: Burst Flight
capabilities: 1/short rest: fly up to your Speed in a straight line; you must land by the end of the movement.
If damaged while airborne, make a DC 10 CON save or descend safely (forced landing).
limits: No hovering; limited turning; cannot carry another creature.

aerial_mastery_ladder.name: Short Sustained Flight
capabilities: PB/long rest: fly for up to 1 minute (concentration-like focus not required unless GM adds).
You can change direction normally; you must spend movement each round to remain airborne (no free hover).
limits: Medium armor increases Aerial Strain triggers by +1; heavy armor prohibits sustained flight unless feature overrides.

aerial_mastery_ladder.name: Tactical Flight
capabilities: Flight speed equals walking speed while airborne during allowed duration.
Hovering allowed if you spend at least 10 ft movement that turn (or a feature waives).
limits: Severe conditions still trigger Aerial Strain.

aerial_mastery_ladder.name: Mastery
capabilities: Hovering and tight maneuvering are reliable.
You may carry one willing creature of your size or smaller at half speed (GM may require STR/CON checks in storms).
limits: Extreme hazards (Keairvari storms, Kaldraun veilstorms) can still force checks/strain.

integration_notes: Flight is expressed as a species trait, feat, class feature, or magic—this ladder defines the default balancing progression if you want flight as a core ancestry feature.
If a class grants magical flight (e.g., spell), use standard D&D spell rules; optionally apply Aerial Strain only in severe conditions.

counterplay: A witnessed vow (spoken aloud, agreed by the group) reduces Sacred Weight by 1 immediately.
Completing a declared waypoint/purpose reduces by 1 (once per day).
Ashwalker chant-circle rest: a short rest with a binding chant reduces by 2 (requires quiet and time).
Compassionate act in a despair hotspot (burying the dead, rescuing a lost traveler) reduces by 1.

Until addressed, long rest benefits are reduced (no exhaustion recovery, or no hit dice recovery—GM choose).

counterplay: A true shelter short rest reduces Frost Lock by 1; a fortified shelter reduces by 2.
Fire/heat used carefully (without attracting storms/predators) reduces by 1.
Aurora-path navigation done respectfully can prevent one trigger per day.
Frostborn cairn offering grants a one-time immunity to increasing Frost Lock for the next travel scene.

On hit, reduce target speed by 10 ft; if already reduced, impose Restrained until end of next turn (save).

build_steps: Pull baseline chassis targets and apply role modifiers
Select 1 trait + 1 action + 1 twist graft keyed to primary element (or theme)
If domain-linked, select one threshold package (track 2/4/6)
Assign counterplay: Standard=2, Elite=3, Boss=4; ensure category diversity
Write statblock using template; add tags

rules: Weapons use standard 5e-like baseline stats; Calanthor adds tags and optional non-combat resonance hooks.
Resonance hooks must not add flat bonuses to hit/damage/AC.
One-Modifier Rule applies to any advantage/+PB granted by hooks.

resonance_hook.effect: On a successful Athletics check to resist forced movement or to shove, prevent one KHALSARRA_WEIGHT overlay tick this obstacle.
When you hit a creature in difficult terrain you created, you may push it 5 ft (no save).
If you begin your turn in snow/fog, you can attempt to Hide (no action) before moving (normal hiding rules apply).
Advantage on Survival checks to build emergency shelter or read drift-lines (Procedure Checks; One-Modifier Rule).
Action: scrape and burn growth from a 5-ft square to end one spore/difficult-terrain patch for 1 round.
When you would become Haunted or Silenced, reduce duration by one step.
If you take an action to protect an ally, grant that ally +1 on its next Procedure Check this scene (no stacking).
Action: splash/cleanse to grant advantage on one save vs poison/disease this scene to a creature you can reach.
Signal across distance; allies who see the signal gain +1 on next navigation Procedure Check this scene (no stacking).
When you would gain Minor Strain from heat or a FIRE technique, ignore it (vent heat through chain rhythm).
